title: Stacks & Queues: LIFO and FIFO disciplines

chapters.title: Stack: LIFO push to the top
facts: A stack follows Last In, First Out (LIFO)
Push adds an element to the top of the stack in O(1)

chapters.title: Stack: popping from the top
facts: Pop removes the top element of the stack in O(1)
Popping an empty stack is an underflow

chapters.title: Queue: FIFO enqueue at the rear
facts: A queue follows First In, First Out (FIFO)
Enqueue adds an element at the rear in O(1)

chapters.title: Queue: circular wrap-around
facts: Dequeue removes the element at the front in O(1)
circular queue computes the next index as (index + 1) mod capacity

chapters.title: Summary of LIFO and FIFO operations
facts: Push adds an element to the top of the stack in O(1)
Pop removes the top element of the stack in O(1)
Enqueue adds an element at the rear in O(1)
Dequeue removes the element at the front in O(1)
